source.description: Reviewed handmade raster graphite and restrained colored-pencil process contact sheet.
source.notes: One face-free three-quarter-view clawfoot bathtub; no labels, arrows, numbers, UI, signatures, watermarks, towels, plants, bubbles, person, room scene, or decorative border.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels lock one three-quarter tub envelope, oval rim, faucet anchors, and three visible foot positions before contours, hardware, texture, or color, then reserve the final panel for reinforcement only.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one tilted rim ellipse, one shallow tub box, three foot ticks, one faucet route with two handle ticks, and one broken shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: One tilted rim ellipse over one shallow three-quarter tub box
anchor_map.becomes: One long oval bathtub rim and one tapered enamel tub body seen from above and the front-right corner
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The left end stays slightly higher and narrower in perspective, the right end stays closer and broader, and the same center axis holds in every panel.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale ellipse, axis, and box only in Panel 1; the body silhouette begins in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: Exactly three foot ticks beneath the tub body
anchor_map.becomes: Exactly three visible curved claw feet attached beneath the same tub body
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Two feet sit along the nearer lower edge and one far-left foot remains visible behind; none float, swap, or change count.
anchor_map.construction_note: Ticks only until the feet are wrapped in Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: One short curved faucet route and two handle ticks on the far-right rim
anchor_map.becomes: One arched faucet centered between exactly two cross handles
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: All three fixtures remain attached to the far-right rim deck and never move inside the basin or onto the outer wall.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open route and ticks only until the fixtures are shaped in Panel 4.

final_elements.name: tub rim body foot faucet and shadow construction guides
final_elements.description: One tilted rim ellipse, one shallow body box, three foot ticks, one faucet route, two handle ticks, and one broken shadow route.

final_elements.name: three-quarter tub silhouette inner basin and rim
final_elements.description: One long doubled oval rim, one nested inner basin contour, and one tapered outer tub wall in a stable three-quarter view.

final_elements.name: three visible claw feet
final_elements.description: Exactly three attached curved feet wrapped into the reserved lower-wall gaps.

final_elements.name: arched faucet two cross handles and drain
final_elements.description: One arched faucet, exactly two cross handles on the far-right rim, and one small drain ellipse inside the basin.

final_elements.name: enamel highlights foot joints and broken ground shadow
final_elements.description: Exactly two open-paper enamel highlights, small joints on the same three feet, and one broken graphite shadow.

final_elements.name: graphite value and restrained seafoam brass and cool-gray color map
final_elements.description: Directional graphite, pale seafoam enamel, restrained warm brass fixtures and feet, and cool-gray basin and ground shadow.

final_elements.name: enamel depth metal accents and paper highlights
final_elements.description: Small established rim shadows, foot contact darks, fixture accents, graphite grain, and open-paper highlights.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The lower tub wall stops at all three reserved foot contacts so no finished wall keeper line is erased when the feet are added.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: arched faucet two cross handles and drain
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The far-right rim deck stops around the faucet route and two handle ticks so no finished rim keeper line must be erased for the fixtures.

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthen established keeper contours, deepen mapped graphite and restrained color, and clarify the same tub, three feet, basin, faucet, two handles, drain, highlights, and shadow.
allowed_changes: small established enamel metal and shadow clarification

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, drifting rim perspective, or a tub that changes viewpoint, scale, end width, or center axis.
Reject missing or extra tubs, rims, basins, feet, faucets, handles, drains, highlights, or a fixture that moves off the far-right rim deck.
Reject a final that introduces water, bubbles, towels, plants, a person, room details, lettering, or props absent earlier.
Reject vector-like linework, glossy rendering, repeated darkened tracings, labels, arrows, numbers, text, signatures, or watermarks.
